steps.en: Start the container with the in-browser config editor switched on
steps.zh: 启动容器，并打开浏览器内配置功能

steps.en: Open the UI and enter your cluster's bootstrap servers
steps.zh: 打开界面，填上集群的 bootstrap 地址

steps.en: Connects as a Kafka client and reads brokers, topics, partitions and consumer-group offsets live
steps.zh: 以 Kafka 客户端连上集群，实时读 broker、topic、分区和位点

steps.en: Click into a topic or a consumer group
steps.zh: 点进某个 topic 或某个消费组

steps.en: Shows per-partition lag and decodes messages as JSON, text, Avro or Protobuf
steps.zh: 显示各分区积压，把消息解码成 JSON、文本、Avro 或 Protobuf

value.en: Anyone on the team can see what's in a topic and why a consumer lags, without CLI tools or client configs
value.zh: 团队里谁都能看到 topic 里有什么、消费组为什么积压，不用命令行工具和客户端配置

sources: README.md @ master (last commit 2024-04-08): Quick start (docker run -it -p 8080:8080 -e DYNAMIC_CONFIG_ENABLED=true provectuslabs/kafka-ui — the card drops the interactive -it flag to fit; 'access the web UI at http://localhost:8080'); Persistent installation (config.yml mounted at /etc/kafkaui/dynamic_config.yaml); 'Web UI Cluster Configuration Wizard'; Features (View Consumer Groups — per-partition parked offsets and lag; Browse Messages — JSON, plain text, Avro; custom serde plugins); Schema registry (Avro, JSON Schema, Protobuf)
